definitions.explanation: The most basic and essential element from which everything else arises. Used to describe the underlying cause, principle, or foundation of something.

examples.japanese: {根本|こんぽん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: We need to reconsider it from the ground up.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根本|こんぽん}{的|てき}な⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧だ。
examples.english: This is the fundamental cause of the problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根本|こんぽん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}えなければ→変える：01089_kaeru⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}される→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧。
examples.english: If we don't change the foundation of the system, the same problems will keep recurring.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根本|こんぽん}{的|てき}な: fundamental, radical
- {根本|こんぽん}⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧: root cause
- {根本|こんぽん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧: to change from the roots
- {根本|こんぽん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見直|みなお}す→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧: to fundamentally reconsider

SIMILAR WORDS:
{根本|こんぽん} emphasizes going back to the very origin or basis. ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧ (basic, fundamental) is more neutral and practical, referring to the basics one builds on. ⟦{根底|こんてい}→根底：13115_kontei⟧ (foundation) is similar but often used in the phrase ⟦{根底|こんてい}→根底：13115_kontei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to underlie).
